TabBar.summary: Tab bar control: creates a TabBarItem per tabs entry and manages the selection. Inherits from LayoutPanel.

props.orientation: Layout orientation; default "horizontal" (tabs side by side)
props.resizeItems: When true the item sizes stretch with the bar; default false
props.centerItems: When true the items are centered as a group; default false
props.padding: Tab bar padding {left, top, right, bottom}
props.itemPadding: Padding of each item {left, top, right, bottom}
props.itemMargin: Margin of each item {left, top, right, bottom}
props.tabs: Table of tab labels; New creates one TabBarItem per entry
props.selected: Label selected initially; nil selects the first one
props.OnChange: Event table invoked when the selected tab changes, with the tab label as argument

TabBar:New.desc: Creates a TabBarItem for each entry of tabs, adds a "tab" when there is none, then selects selected.

TabBar:SetOrientation.desc: Sets the layout orientation by delegating to the LayoutPanel (parent) implementation.

TabBar:Select.desc: Selects the tab whose caption matches: updates selected_obj and state.selected and fires OnChange.

params.tabname: Label text (caption) of the tab to select

TabBar:Select.returns: true when found and selected; when not found it may select the first tab and return false

fileDesc: Tab bar control: generates TabBarItem children from tabs and handles selection changes and OnChange notifications.
